_meta.purpose: Corrected parser configuration for the eCoA_DATABASE dataset.
_meta.apply: PATCH {RAGFLOW_API_SERVER}/api/v1/datasets/f29f8f58a13c11f1858cf58865604f65 — strip every key beginning with '_' first; the API rejects unknown fields.
_meta.baseline: Read live 30.08.2026. Only the fields in _changes differ.
_meta.scope: Improves narrative retrieval. Numbers come from the typed extraction, not from these chunks.

_changes.chunk_method: naive -> table. A certificate is a form wrapped around a results table; naive split it on newlines into 1536-token blobs, which is why 9 of 17 sampled certificates yielded no extractable result at all.
_changes.parser_config.chunk_token_num: 1536 -> 512. One results table per chunk instead of a whole certificate.
_changes.parser_config.table_column_names: null -> the three column headers, so a result stays bound to its parameter and its limit.
_changes.parser_config.table_column_roles: null -> key/limit/value, so a limit is distinguishable from a measurement downstream.
_changes.parser_config.table_column_mode: null -> explicit, to use the names above rather than inferring per document.
_changes.parser_config.table_context_size: 0 -> 1, keeping the header row with the rows it labels.
_changes.parser_config.auto_keywords: 4 -> 0. Generated keywords add nothing to a templated certificate and cost a model call per chunk.
_changes.parser_config.layout_recognize: UNCHANGED at gpt-4.1@openai-vlm. Vision was never the weak link — the measured failure was structural.
_changes.parser_config.raptor.use_raptor: UNCHANGED. Whether RAPTOR and GraphRAG both earn their cost is open item E2 and a separate decision.
